sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Designed by OMA / David Gianotten and Mariano Sagasta, The Martin consists of four interlocking volumes and is defined by a layered, permeable facade with continuous balconies along its perimeter. It forms the latest addition to OMA's masterplan to transform the former Bijlmerbajes prison (1978–2016) into a sustainable neighborhood integrated into the city's urban fabric.
